All paths below are relative to `vendor/steel-compendium/en/unified/md/`. No tests, generators, browser, backend or online rules research.

## Inventory and progression

Read `class/shadow.md#Shadow Advancement Table`, all 14 feature files under `feature/shadow/level-{4,5,6}`, and all 11 ability files under `feature/ability/shadow/level-{4,5,6}`. Features: six at level4, five at level5, three at level6. Envelopes: Night Watch at4, four general 9-Insight options at5, six college 9-Insight options at6. Feature-file counts include selectors, not just named mechanics. Preserve all previously earned levels1–3 grants/choices; no level7 grants.

| Level | Automatic | New selections |

| 4 | Agility becomes3; Keep It Down; Night Watch passive AND triggered action; Surge of Insight | Increase one characteristic by1, max3; any one perk; any one skill |
| 5 | College feature: Black Ash→Trail of Cinders, Caustic Alchemy→Volatile Reagents, Harlequin Mask→Harlequin Gambit | One general 9-Insight ability from four |

`feature/shadow/level-4/characteristic-increase.md`: A increases **to3**, plus one characteristic increases by1 capped3. Since A is already3 after the fixed increase, it cannot be raised to4. Other choices are M/R/I/P; enforce cap against evaluated pre-increase value. Do not reassign the level-one array or make level4 an arbitrary two-point increase. Agility potency becomes weak1/average2/strong3 at levels4–6 (`class/shadow.md#Basics`). Equality resists.

`level-4/perk.md`, `level-6/perk.md`, `level-4/skill.md` say any perk/skill, not a restricted class pool. Existing chosen skills/perks must remain coherent with shared duplicate/reselection rules. Do not make both new perk decisions overwrite level2's choice.

Class Stamina is18+6*(level−1): 36/42/48 at4/5/6, before kit/ancestry/perk effects. `rule/general/echelon.md` makes levels4–6 second echelon. `chapter/kits.md#Stamina Bonus` scales kit Stamina by echelon. For an otherwise unmodified Human with Cloak and Dagger (`kit/cloak-and-dagger.md`), +3 per echelon now contributes6, giving max42/48/54, Recovery14/16/18 and winded21/24/27. Recoveries remain8, speed7, disengage2, stability0 unless chosen traits/perks change them. Kit damage stays its printed +1/+1/+1; echelon does not multiply damage bonuses.

## Features and embedded uses

Each feature below cites `feature/shadow/level-N/<slug>.md`.

- **4 Keep It Down (`keep-it-down`)**: while conversing with a creature sharing a language, choose whether others can perceive the communication, even yelling. Manual communication control; no universal silence aura.
- **4 Night Watch (`night-watch`)**: while YOU are hidden, enemies take a bane on search tests for you or other hidden creatures within10. Also grants the ability with the same name from the ability directory. Keep passive and action source identities distinct.
- **4 Surge of Insight (`surge-of-insight`)**: the first damage incorporating one or more surges EACH ROUND grants2 Insight **instead of1**. Replaces the level-one Insight rider, not +2 atop1, not per target or turn. No change to initial Victories or own-turn1d3. If income is manual, replace the displayed instruction too.
- **5 Trail of Cinders (`trail-of-cinders`)**: reducing any non-minion to0 permits an immediate free maneuver Black Ash Teleport; unlike Harlequin there is no adjacency restriction on the defeated creature. Also bring one adjacent willing creature on ANY shadow-ability teleport; arrival must be unoccupied adjacent to your destination or companion cannot travel. Expose both reaction and passenger use. Free maneuver changes timing, not an unconditional waiver of Black Ash Teleport's optional paid extension.
- **5 Volatile Reagents (`volatile-reagents`)**: whenever you take damage, every adjacent enemy takes A damage of your choice fire/acid/poison (3 at these levels). No once-per-round restriction printed. Defensive Roll now shifts up to5 including vertically; fall if ending off solid ground without flying. This replaces its old shift2; preserve half-damage, source timing after triggering effect, hide option and optional1 Insight potency reduction from level1. Reactive damage/type/adjacency remain manual unless specifically modeled.
- **5 Harlequin Gambit (`harlequin-gambit`)**: reduce ADJACENT non-minion to0 → immediate free maneuver I'm No Threat, then move up to speed. SAME SIZE permits victim disguise without Insight and makes victim body look like yours; interaction with corpse or ending either illusion ends both. Expose triggered use and the specifically free same-size disguise. Do not waive ordinary impersonation globally or for differently sized victims. Preserve Friend's existing Disengage component of I'm No Threat and its normal ending rules.
- **6 Umbral Form (`umbral-form`)**: maneuver activation, no printed Insight cost. Lasts until encounter end, dying, or one uninterrupted hour of quiet focus outside combat. While active: climb full speed; enemy spaces not difficult terrain; A corruption damage first passage through each enemy's space on a TURN; automatically hidden from each creature from which you end turn covered/concealed; own-turnstart1surge; corruption immunity5+level=11 at6; enemies have edge on strikes against you; bane on Presence interaction tests. These are conditional form benefits and penalties, NOT permanent sheet bonuses. Do not invent free at-will exit or omit liabilities. Expose passage damage and start-turn surge/automatic-hide instructions if effects remain manual.

## Resource, kit and inherited-path checks

`feature/shadow/level-1/insight.md`: rolled heroic with edge/double edge costs1 less (any one target is sufficient for multitarget), and outside combat costs waived with reuse restriction until Victory/respite. Carry established manual/automated handling forward accurately; a no-roll effect such as Blackout is not entitled to the rolled-ability edge discount. Night Watch/Umbral Form/free feature reactions have no invented9-cost. Embedded Blackout free strike, potion consumption and Harlequin free disguise must not pay parent9 again.

`chapter/kits.md#Damage Bonuses`: Melee+Weapon or Ranged+Weapon, not Strike alone, controls kit damage. Example Cloak+1 gives Into the Shadows12/17/21 at the RETURN roll, Shadowfall11/15/21, You Talk Too Much14/19/25, Black Ash Eruption7/10/13, Puppet Strings3/6/8. Its ranged-distance+5 also applies to Night Watch (ranged10), because Ranged+Weapon; it does not apply to either vial (no Weapon), Cinderstorm (no Ranged), or expand areas. Verify each attack's selected melee/ranged delivery where both are printed.

Carry lower-level characteristic-dependent features forward (notably Burning Ash: first qualifying teleport on a turn deals A fire) rather than freezing amounts at level3. Preserve Trained Assassin separately: a strike with no bane that incorporates surges gets one additional surge usable only on that strike; do not confuse this with Surge of Insight income. Characteristic increase changes all A-based rolls, damage, potency and feature amounts, including previously earned abilities. Level4 kit Stamina must also update persisted admission/recovery baselines consistently with normal leveling rules.

## Proof expectations and uncertainty boundary

Use source-derived builds for levels4,5,6, all three colleges, both level6 alternatives, all four level5 alternatives, all characteristic-increase choices and both new perk slots. Retain level1–3 choices. Check class/college changes prune only obsolete later grants, stale revision refusal and unauthorized edits, save/resume/admission readback, and reject level7 unless separately authorized.

Every new action and embedded use needs shared UI/API presence, source labels, actual cost/block/waiver behavior as supported, and persisted readback. Invoking a recorded manual instruction proves that record/payment only. For You Talk Too Much, if compiled, prove applied/resisted including equality at1/2/3 and source-linked save instance; preserve encounter-long communication as manual. For timing-sensitive actions prove the initial command cannot automatically resolve damage before its prerequisite. If Black Ash Eruption is partially compiled, preserve vertical and straight-up qualifiers in its result/readback.

Umbral Form benefits/penalties and feature triggers may remain explicit manual where no state machine exists. Do not infer automation merely from source visibility. Same-size Harlequin free disguise is narrower than normal paid impersonation; free-maneuver Trail teleport is not a global teleport cost exemption. Cinderstorm's “can use Hide” does not explicitly grant a free action, unlike Blackout's explicitly free triggered action: retain printed wording instead of granting extra economy.

No unresolved source question prevents authoring the stated choices/grants. If implementing timing or conditional adjudication beyond these printed instructions exposes ambiguity, record it in docs/rules-questions-for-user.md and keep the affected part manual. This audit provides no approval of future implementation or test results.
